author: Squander23
quote: After 13 years, 3 delays, and 2 billion dollars, they couldn't even give us more than 20fps. They couldn't even polish the game. I usually give grace to games that had this. I gave Cyberpunk the benefit of the doubt when it first came out but Rockstar has no excuse. The expectations were through the roof. This game was supposed to be generation defining. But it just ended up having fanboys justify lowering everyone’s standards in what gaming should be in 2026. I cannot give grace to a company who paid off every critic to ignore all the problems that this game has. It’s fun but it is definitely not the generation defining game that was promised. It is definitely not a 10/10. At most it could be a 7. But I’m leaving a 0 just to be as disingenuous as the 10s were. That’s what this game deserves.
